evals.name: calmer-british-voice-and-blend
evals.prompt: the sample narration (input\sample.md) sounds too fast and a bit bright for me. i want a calmer british male narrator, a bit slower, with longer gaps between paragraphs. what exact command do i run? and can i do a blend of two british guys but mostly george?
evals.expected_output: Exact generate.py command using .venv python, a British male voice (bm_george), speed below 1, pause above 0.4, --force or the file named; weighted blend via repeating names (bm_george,bm_george,bm_fable) or a .pt approach; suggests previewing.
assertions: Gives a george-weighted blend that works (repetition or weighted tensor)
Runs via .venv python or generate.bat (never system python)

evals.name: sa-bakery-script-pronunciation
evals.prompt: Write me a short narration script (around 150 words) for a promo about our new bakery opening in Pietermaritzburg on 3/4/2026. Mention: sourdough is R45 a loaf, call us on 082 555 1234, we're at 12 St. George's St. Make sure Kokoro will actually read all of it correctly.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown/txt narration script with the date, rand price, phone number and street spelled out in words, no 'St.' abbreviations, paragraphs separated by blank lines, and a note about the hard-to-pronounce town name.
assertions: No 'R' + digits rand amounts in script
No numeric slash date in script
Phone number not left as digits
Paragraphs separated by blank lines (3+ paragraphs)
No misaki link syntax inside a .md script (would be stripped)
Answer addresses how Pietermaritzburg will be pronounced

evals.name: windows-offline-gpu-troubleshooting
evals.prompt: every time i run generate.bat i get 'To support symlinks on Windows, you either need to activate Developer Mode...' and it says 'Loading Kokoro on cpu'. also i tried --voice bf_emma on the plane with no wifi and it crashed. whats going on and how do i fix all three?
evals.expected_output: Explains symlink warning is harmless (HF_HUB_DISABLE_SYMLINKS_WARNING), CPU fallback means torch CUDA not available (check with torch.cuda.is_available, reinstall cu128 torch, driver), voices download lazily so pre-download while online (snapshot_download / run once) and HF_HUB_OFFLINE.
assertions: CPU: points to cu128 torch build for RTX 5050/Blackwell
Offline: explains voices download on first use
Does not tell user to install system espeak-ng
